newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canon sees 1996 parent current 125 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Canon sees 1996 parent current 125 bln yen.

text.p: Canon Inc said on Monday that it expects to post a parent current profit of 125 billion yen for the year to December 31, 1996, up 56 percent from the previous year, thanks to robust sales of its computer-related products.
It said it also expects the weaker yen to have increased its export income for the year by 60 billion yen.
A company spokesman said the firm expects sales to have grown 13 percent year on year, to about 1.4 trillion yen, due mainly to a 22 percent rise in sales of computer peripherals such as printers.
The spokesman also said that the company plans an annual dividend of 15 yen for 1996, which would include 2 yen to commemorate the firm's 60th anniversary.
